evals.prompt: Our tally repository is exported as the git bundle tally/tally.bundle. Clone it with `git clone tally/tally.bundle tally-repo`. Then update tally-repo/CHANGELOG.md with everything that changed since v1.1.0. We use Conventional Commits, but don't trust the commit messages blindly. No release yet, so keep it under Unreleased, and don't commit, tag, or push.
evals.expected_output: Unreleased entries traced to the commits in v1.1.0..HEAD, written for users: Added --json; Fixed words separated by tabs/newlines and file names that look like options; Changed: the Python 3.10 requirement marked breaking with the migration (upgrade Python), and the default --min-length changing from 1 to 2 (found in the diff of the 'chore: tidy option defaults' commit); no entries for the docs, CI, or test commits; released sections untouched; audit_changelog.py passes; no tags.

assertions.check: R=$(cd "$EVAL_OUTPUTS_DIR" && pwd -P); until [ -f "$R/skills/update-changelogs/scripts/audit_changelog.py" ]; do [ "$R" = / ] && { echo "audit_changelog.py not found above $EVAL_OUTPUTS_DIR" >&2; exit 3; }; R=$(dirname "$R"); done; T="$R/skills/update-changelogs/scripts/audit_changelog.py"; python3 -I "$T" tally-repo/CHANGELOG.md

assertions.text: The Unreleased section covers --json, the tab/newline fix, and the Python 3.10 requirement.
assertions.check:
python3 - tally-repo/CHANGELOG.md <<'PY'
import re, sys
text = open(sys.argv[1], encoding='utf-8').read()
def section(title):
    m = re.search(r'^## \[' + re.escape(title) + r'\][^\n]*\n(.*?)(?=^## \[|^\[[^\]]+\]: |\Z)', text, re.M | re.S)
    return m.group(1) if m else None
def released_tail(t):
    start = t.find('\n## [', t.find('## [Unreleased]') + 1)
    end = t.find('\n[kac]:')
    return t[start:end].strip()
u = section('Unreleased') or ''
ok = '--json' in u and re.search(r'tab', u, re.I) and '3.10' in u
print(u)
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
PY

assertions.check:
python3 - exporter/CHANGELOG.md <<'PY'
import re, sys
text = open(sys.argv[1], encoding='utf-8').read()
def section(title):
    m = re.search(r'^## \[' + re.escape(title) + r'\][^\n]*\n(.*?)(?=^## \[|^\[[^\]]+\]: |\Z)', text, re.M | re.S)
    return m.group(1) if m else None
def released_tail(t):
    start = t.find('\n## [', t.find('## [Unreleased]') + 1)
    end = t.find('\n[kac]:')
    return t[start:end].strip()
u = section('Unreleased') or ''
cats = dict((m.group(1), m.group(2)) for m in re.finditer(r'^### (\w+)\n(.*?)(?=^### |\Z)', u, re.M | re.S))

PY
